Sandbox_MNWBEnableWorldSpawn_tooltip:
Wheelbarrows can be found lying around construction sites, warehouses and tool stores.
Turn off to make them craft-only.
Sandbox_MNWBSpawnChance_tooltip:
Percent chance of a wheelbarrow spawning at an eligible spot.
Each spot is only ever rolled once.
Sandbox_MNWBEnableCrafting_tooltip: Enables the recipe to build a wheelbarrow from scratch.
Sandbox_MNWBCapacity_tooltip:
How much the wheelbarrow can hold, counted the way the game counts it: heavy cargo is repacked and takes a fifth of the room, so 38 is around 21 logs or 4 generators, while light loot takes its full weight.
38 is the game's own ceiling for a container standing on the ground, so this option only makes the wheelbarrow smaller, never bigger.
Load it while it sits on the ground; the game does not allow heavy items into a container you are holding.
Sandbox_MNWBLightCapacity_tooltip:
A separate, much lower ceiling for items BELOW the heavy threshold.
Heavy cargo is repacked and takes a fifth of the room; light loot is not, and gets no weight relief either. This caps how much of it you can bring along.
Set to 0 to remove the light limit entirely.
Sandbox_MNWBHeavyThreshold_tooltip:
Items at or above this weight count as heavy and get the weight reduction.
Anything lighter gets nothing at all; the wheelbarrow is deliberately useless for small loot.
Sandbox_MNWBHeavyReduction_tooltip:
How much weight is taken off heavy items, in percent.
Light items are never reduced, no matter this setting.
Sandbox_MNWBActionDuration_tooltip:
How long it takes to lift or set down the wheelbarrow.
Longer means cancelling it by accident is a real risk.
Sandbox_MNWBSpillOnCancel_tooltip:
Cancelling the pick up or put down animation makes the wheelbarrow tip over, dumping its contents and itself on the ground.
Turn off for a forgiving game.
Sandbox_MNWBBlockRunning_tooltip:
Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow is a walk, not a jog.
Turn off to keep running available at the reduced speed.
Sandbox_MNWBAllowCorpses_tooltip:
Lets bodies be loaded into the wheelbarrow.
Turn off if hauling corpses makes clearing a house too easy for your taste.
